title: Switchdev standing-rig configuration
description: Rig description consumed by bin/switchdev_test.py. Point checkbox config var SWITCHDEV_RIG_CONFIG at a file following this schema (bare filenames resolve against the provider data/ directory). Each job only requires the keys it uses.

expected_ports.description: Expected number of fabric netdevs (phys_switch_id). Required by: port-count

reserved_ports.description: Netdevs tests must never touch (infra/management uplink). Used by: resource, link-flap

vlan_baseline.description: Path of the saved known-good `bridge vlan` baseline JSON. Required by: vlan-drift

chain.description: Standing loop-cable chain endpoints. Required by: offload-proof

entry_ip.description: CIDR for the entry SVI, e.g. 10.101.0.1/24

exit_ip.description: CIDR for the exit SVI, same subnet

mid_port.description: A fabric port mid-chain whose counters must carry the test traffic

rstp_fixture_ports.description: The same-VLAN cabled fixture pair, admin-down in standing state. Required by: rstp-fixture
